# Contact card — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the contact card when a contact needs the full identity treatment: large disc, name, supporting line, presence and actions. `contact` is the same adapter the row takes, so a row promotes to a card without remapping, and the large disc resolves tones the same way the row disc does, so the two never disagree. `status` slots the `StatusPill`, so presence reads through the tone registry rather than a custom badge, and `actions` slots host-owned call, chat and email buttons — there are no built-in actions, and dialling, messaging and mailing stay host-owned. There is no card-wide activation either: a card that navigates wraps in the host's own link, because the card never nests a button inside a button. The initials fallback keeps the card complete before any photo loads.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the contact card when a contact needs the full identity treatment: large disc, name, detail, presence and actions — the native twin under the same contract. `contact` is the same adapter the row takes, so a row promotes to a card without remapping, and the large disc resolves tones the same way the row disc does, so the two never disagree. `status` slots the `StatusPill`, so presence reads through the tone registry rather than a custom badge, and `actions` slots host-owned call, chat and email buttons — there are no built-in actions, and dialling, messaging and mailing stay host-owned. There is no card-wide activation: actions stay separate controls after the identity and never nest inside one, and the initials fallback keeps the card complete before any photo loads.
